newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius rupee firms vs dollar, weakens vs stg.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius rupee firms vs dollar, weakens vs stg.

text.p: The Mauritian rupee firmed against dollar but weakened against sterling on Monday reflecting international market trends, forex dealers said.
The rupee was fixed at a mean rate of 20.369 to the dollar from 20.4535 on last Friday, and at a commercial mean rate of 33.4835 to the sterling from 33.2745 on last Friday.
"The weakening of dollar in overnight international markets was caused by unexpected lead by left-wing parties in first round of French elections on last Sunday," one dealer said.

Forex dealers said that on the local market some commercial banks were in need of dollars but the central bank would not intervene on the foreign exchange interbank market to-day because it was a public holiday in the United States.
